disease: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, X-linked (AVPR2 loss-of-function; vasopressin V2 receptor)

emergence.disease: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, X-linked (AVPR2 loss-of-function; vasopressin V2 receptor)
emergence.summary: X-linked nephrogenic diabetes insipidus (NDI) is caused by INACTIVATING (loss-of-function) mutations of AVPR2, the gene encoding the arginine-vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R) -- a Gs-coupled G-PROTEIN-COUPLED RECEPTOR on the basolateral membrane of the renal collecting-duct principal cell (chrXq28). In health, circulating vasopressin (antidiuretic hormone) binds V2R, which activates Gs -> adenylate cyclase -> cAMP -> PKA, driving aquaporin-2 (AQP2) water channels to the apical membrane so water is reabsorbed and urine is concentrated. AVPR2 LOF (the majority are MISSENSE mutations whose receptor MISFOLDS and is retained in the endoplasmic reticulum, never reaching the membrane) abolishes that vasopressin-driven cAMP signal: the collecting duct cannot insert AQP2 and cannot concentrate urine despite high or therapeutic vasopressin -> massive dilute polyuria, polydipsia, recurrent hypernatraemic dehydration. The kit reads this as the V2R -> cAMP -> AQP2 water-reabsorption DRIVE removed (role accelerator -- the hormone-response drive -- mechanism LOF -> emergent axis DOWN on urine-concentrating throughput), the SAME accelerator/LOF/axis-DOWN shape as leptin-receptor deficiency (LEPR), now on a different receptor and a different axis. This is the kit's FIRST GPCR axis and its FIRST receptor-signalling / second-messenger (cAMP) axis -- distinct from the kit's ION-CHANNEL receptor reads (CFTR, K_ATP, NaV1.5/NaV1.1): those are channels carrying a current, V2R is a metabotropic GPCR transducing a hormone into a second messenger. Correction is to RESTORE the V2R -> cAMP -> AQP2 drive. Because most AVPR2 mutants are MISFOLDED-but-intrinsically-functional receptors trapped in the ER, the lead switch-level direction is to RESCUE the receptor's folding/trafficking so it reaches the membrane and signals again: cell-permeant non-peptide pharmacological CHAPERONES (some of which are also biased AGONISTS that directly restore an AVP-dependent cAMP signal on the rescued mutant) do exactly this in vitro and in early proof-of-concept (the V1a/V2 antagonist-chaperone SR49059 / relcovaptan reduced 24-h urine volume in a small NDI patient study; SR121463 and biased-agonist pharmacochaperones rescue many V2R mutants in cell systems). HONESTLY: this is a research strategy, NOT an approved or actively-developed therapy -- no pharmacochaperone is approved for NDI, the chaperone approach rescues MISSENSE/misfolding mutants but NOT nonsense/null alleles (genotype-dependent), and AVPR2 gene/function restoration is preclinical. So the kit ships this as the Huntington pattern (DNA readable, lead switch-level lever investigational, not a clean approved switch-drug; direction [F], magnitude [O]). The conventional clinical MANAGEMENT -- thiazide diuretics + amiloride, a low-solute (low-salt, reduced-protein) diet, and NSAIDs (indomethacin) -- reduces urine volume by paradoxical / prostaglandin mechanisms that do NOT restore V2R signalling, so it is recorded as DOWNSTREAM-symptomatic and is deliberately NOT added as a switch lever (the Rett/trofinetide, XLH/oral-phosphate, HPP/vitamin-D downstream-agent discipline). The AUTOSOMAL-recessive/-dominant forms of NDI, caused by AQP2 mutations (the downstream water channel), are a distinct genotype on the SAME axis (the receptor vs the channel) -- AQP2 is carried as context, not conflated. The gamma read is of the AVPR2 promoter switch STRUCTURE (chrXq28); the disease lesions (missense/misfolding, nonsense, deletions) are coding, outside the promoter firewall. X-linked: hemizygous males affected, carrier females variable by X-inactivation (held [O], the B10 convention). Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: renal collecting-duct urine-concentrating drive -- the vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R) -> Gs -> cAMP -> PKA -> AQP2 apical water-channel insertion axis. AVPR2 LOF (mostly receptor misfolding / ER retention) removes the vasopressin-response drive so water reabsorption fails despite hormone (axis DOWN). The kit's first GPCR axis and first second-messenger (cAMP) receptor-signalling axis, the metabotropic-GPCR contrast to the ion-channel reads (CFTR, K_ATP, NaV)

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: AVPR2 encodes the arginine-vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R), a Gs-coupled GPCR in the renal collecting duct that transduces vasopressin -> cAMP -> AQP2 apical insertion -> water reabsorption. Inactivating (LOF) mutations -- most are missense alleles whose receptor MISFOLDS and is ER-retained -- remove that vasopressin-response drive so the duct cannot concentrate urine (accelerator/LOF -> axis DOWN). chrXq28. NCBI official symbol AVPR2. X-linked NDI = OMIM 304800. Coding lesions; promoter firewall respected.

treatment_A_switch.disease: Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, X-linked (AVPR2 loss-of-function; vasopressin V2 receptor)

levers.push_direction: rescue the misfolded / ER-retained V2R so it traffics to the membrane and signals again (a cell-permeant non-peptide pharmacological chaperone; some are biased agonists that directly restore an AVP-dependent cAMP signal on the rescued mutant) -> restore the V2R->cAMP->AQP2 water-reabsorption drive (axis UP toward normal)
levers.agent_class: cell-permeant non-peptide V2R pharmacological chaperone / biased-agonist pharmacochaperone (SR49059 / relcovaptan; SR121463; biased-agonist pharmacochaperones)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] the degree of receptor rescue and the urine-concentrating MAGNITUDE are not sequence-derived; rescue is GENOTYPE-DEPENDENT -- chaperones rescue missense/misfolding mutants but NOT nonsense/null alleles; NO pharmacochaperone is approved for NDI (SR49059 was an early small-cohort human proof-of-concept), so the approach is investigational; the corrective DIRECTION (restore V2R signalling) is forced [F]
levers.src: Morello 2000 J Clin Invest 105:887 (pharmacological chaperones rescue V2R mutants); Bernier 2006 J Am Soc Nephrol 17:232 (SR49059 reduced urine volume in NDI patients); Jean-Alphonse 2009 J Am Soc Nephrol 20:2190 (biased-agonist pharmacochaperones of V2R)

levers.push_direction: restore functional V2R by gene/function replacement (supply a working AVPR2) -> rebuild the vasopressin->cAMP->AQP2 drive at the receptor
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] delivery to collecting-duct principal cells, expression level and rescue magnitude not derived; preclinical, not approved; direction [F]
levers.src: Conceptual switch-level arm (no clinical AVPR2 gene therapy); cf. collecting-duct gene-delivery challenge reviews

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: AVPR2 LOF moves the collecting-duct urine-concentrating axis DOWN (the vasopressin->cAMP->AQP2 drive is lost)
falsifiers.falsifier: an inactivating AVPR2 allele that PRESERVED or RAISED vasopressin-stimulated cAMP / AQP2 membrane insertion / urine osmolality would refute the drive-lost (axis DOWN) read
falsifiers.measurable_by: vasopressin-stimulated cAMP and apical AQP2 trafficking in AVPR2-mutant collecting-duct / heterologous cells; maximal urine osmolality after desmopressin by genotype

falsifiers.claim: RESCUING V2R signalling (pharmacochaperone) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if restoring V2R surface expression / cAMP signalling FAILED to raise (or lowered) urine-concentrating capacity in misfolding-mutant NDI, the restore-the-drive lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: urine osmolality / AQP2 membrane insertion response to a V2R pharmacochaperone in a misfolding-AVPR2 model or patient
